title: Myrkulite Scourge

sources.title: Tenacity
markers: | summary = '''Tenacity''' is a passive feature that allows the user to apply damage, even on a miss.

sources.title: Concussive Smash
markers: | description = Hit an enemy with all your might to deal damage and possibly {{cond|Dazed|Daze}} them.

sources.title: Weakening Strike
markers: | description = Target an enemy's hands with a non-lethal attack and possibly inflict {{SmCond|Weak Grip}}.

summary: A +1 flail adding 1d6 Necrotic to hits, with main-hand Tenacity.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d8 + 1 Bludgeoning plus Strength modifier, and 1d6 Necrotic. Martial, one-handed, dippable, 5 ft melee.
fields.Tenacity: When main-handed, spend a Reaction on a missed melee attack to deal Strength modifier Bludgeoning, minimum 1. This does not trigger the missed weapon action’s effect, but some equipment on-hit effects can apply.
fields.Concussive Smash: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. On a melee weapon hit, the target makes a Constitution save against the higher of spell save DC or weapon-action DC +2. Failure Dazes for 2 turns, removing Dexterity AC bonus, giving disadvantage on Wisdom saves, and preventing reactions that spend a Reaction point. Help ends Dazed.
fields.Weakening Strike: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. Nonlethal melee attack for 1d4 plus attack ability modifier as weapon damage. Strength save against weapon-action DC +2 or Weak Grip for 2 turns. Weak Grip only affects armed targets, gives disadvantage on attack rolls and Strength saves, and can be removed with Help.
fields.Dual Wielder: The source reports that a miss with a second, non-Tenacity weapon can trigger this flail’s Tenacity.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
